description: This file defines the MyLeaveEntitlementReport class within the OrangeHRM Leave module. It extends an abstract Vue controller, uses traits for leave period services, and prepares a Vue component with leave period data for rendering.

classes.name: MyLeaveEntitlementReport
classes.description: A controller class for preparing the leave entitlement report component with current leave period data for Vue rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with leave period information by fetching the current leave period and setting it as a property in the component.
